items.title: Player interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2012
items.q: one of my buddies, a jazz drummer, Gus Johnson

ctx.x: Did they take auditions for people to get in on the thing?

Yeah, you know, I think that they, you know I’m not sure how all of that completely works, but I mean I think that they make posts for like if they need extras for particular shots or whatever. I don’t know what their process is like to get the stars of the show. However, I do know that the main character, he is a New Orleanian, if I understand correctly, and I think he went to the New Orleans Center for the Creative Arts, which is a great school there for high school students. And then the other part is kind of…

You said something about being protective of the culture. And I was wondering, if I decided I’m going to go to New Orleans and I want to make a living as a musician, what’s it like trying to enter that world and get accepted, and how would I prepare myself?
